basic_info.main_problem: 由于妻子最近Unemployment，我正经历强烈的Anxiety和压力，并not断灾难化地认为她永远找not到新工作。随着时间推移、妻子尚not yet找到新工作，我对not yet来及家庭财务的担忧愈发严重，影响到工作专注、睡眠与饮食，并使夫妻Relationship tension。
basic_info.core_demands: 寻求咨询以学习应对策略并找到管理这些情绪的方法，从而减轻Anxiety与压力对工作专注度和生活的影响。

core_beliefs: Once the economy becomes unstable, the consequences will be catastrophic

special_situations.event: 收到妻子求职的又一封拒信
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果多次被拒，就说明她以后也找not到工作
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessively focuses on application and reply progress, repeatedly rehearsing the worst scenarios in the mind to 'be prepared'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 她可能永远找not到新工作

special_situations.event: 看到妻子持续投递简历但暂时have not回音
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果短时间have not明显进展，就意味着事情正在走向失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles self-pressure, closely monitors progress, repeatedly adjusts budgets and plans to try to control risks

special_situations.event: Thinks about family finances and mortgage/savings at bedtime at night
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I, as the sole income source, have any mishap, the family will collapse
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly calculates the budget and imagines worst outcomes to gain a sense of safety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我们可能会耗尽积蓄、失去房子

special_situations.event: 妻子Unemployment已持续数周仍not yet入职
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果现在还not找到工作，就等于以后也not会找到（非黑即白）
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 用极端标准评判进展，把“not yet立即成功”视为“彻底失败”
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这说明她not会再被录用了

core_conflict.wish: Longing for family stability and safety, and sharing economic pressure with the partner
core_conflict.fear: Fearing losing control, family finances collapsing, and quality of life declining
defense_goal: 通过预先设想最坏情境与持续警觉来维持掌控感、降低not确定带来的Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: Anxiety且必须扛起家庭经济的照料者/守护者
object_relations.object_representation: 处于Unemployment与not确定中的伴侣，需要支持且前景难以掌控

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈及妻子求职受挫或家庭财务not确定性时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将not确定性等同于即将到来的灾难，认为必须通过not断担忧与计划才能避免风险
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气平静、具体化和结构化Questioning；引导其聚焦可控的小步骤与现实证据，温和限制灾难化推演，肯定其已采取的实际应对。

outcomes: 注意力与Decline in work performance
